about: Shared readability specimens. Stream A (hooks/test_authorship_guard.py) and stream B (src/forge/intake/readability.test.ts) both load this file and must produce the same verdict per specimen. A mismatch between the two implementations is a failing test on whichever side reads the file second. Written 2026-09-09 by the authoring session; the streams may add specimens, never delete or weaken one. Amended 2026-09-09 after the goal-forge review (wf_7743a080-402): per-file coverage, the 25-line fence cap, the ceiling flip date, verdict precedence and the flightdeck secret-shape scan were added to the contract, with four specimens. Amended 2026-09-09 (Aaron): the `Not run` section is removed from the PR body and the `Not run` line from the Jira handoff comment, so `required_sections` is three sections and no specimen body carries one; the JoeHandoff `couldNotRun` field goes with them, since nothing renders it.

contract.banned_word_matching: case-insensitive; whole word except the entries ending in a stem (orchestrat, gate G) which match as a prefix; matched in prose only, never inside a fenced code block or inline backticks
contract.required_sections_matching: a markdown heading line (any level) whose text equals the section name, case-insensitive; plus, when diff_stats is present, one heading containing a path:line reference for EVERY production (non-exempt) path in diff_stats, each immediately followed (blank lines allowed) by a fenced code block, and the DENY reason names every undocumented path; when diff_stats is null, at least one such path:line heading plus fence; a required section whose body is empty or whose fence is empty is a padding failure
contract.prose_word_count: strip fenced code blocks (``` to ```), strip heading lines, strip inline backtick spans, then count whitespace-separated tokens
contract.words_deny_from_note: provisional; recomputed as two weeks after stream C's first replacement PR opens. Before this date an over-ceiling count ADVISEs; on or after it, DENY.
contract.cannot_measure: when diff_stats is null (no base, git failed) the verdict is ADVISE with reason containing 'cannot measure'; never SILENT
contract.off_switch: HARNESS_READABILITY_OFF=1 makes every specimen SILENT; every DENY reason text names this variable
contract.scope_note: surfaces on a repo not in outward_repos are SILENT regardless of content; jira surfaces are always in scope
contract.fence_max_lines_note: a fenced code block under a path:line heading longer than 25 lines DENYs with a reason containing '25'; not date-gated
contract.production_ceiling_note: Aaron, 2026-09-09 (Revised rule): the ceiling ADVISEs during the pilot and DENYs on or after words_deny_from, the same date constant as the word count; there is no separate ceiling date
contract.verdict_precedence: DENY beats ADVISE beats SILENT when several checks fire; the reason lists every firing check

secret_shape.scope: flightdeck only (the hook does not scan for secrets)
secret_shape.matched_in: the full rendered title and body, prose and fences alike, case-insensitive
shapes: an assignment whose key is password, token, secret, apikey or api_key (any case, = or :) with a non-placeholder value
secret_shape.passes: an environment variable name alone, e.g. TEST_DB_CONNECTION_STRING

specimens.body:
## What breaks

An ACH deposit that Sila reports twice is credited to the CWA twice.

## What changes

The second webhook for the same transfer id is ignored.

### BoltBetz.ManagementSystem/Sila/SilaWebhookClaim.cs:24

```csharp
if (!await claims.TryClaimAsync(transferId)) return Ok();
```

The claim row is unique per transfer id, so only one request wins.

## How to run

```
dotnet test --filter SilaWebhookClaimConcurrencyTest
```
The council found the fee is charged twice when both fields are missing. Fix is in PR 80.
This basically moves the check up one line so the null case is caught first.

The retry uses the same id:

```csharp
var lens = request.ClientRequestId;
```
